Helping Military Youth Thrive

For over 20 years, we have been dedicated to empowering military youth with the tools to learn, grow, and succeed.

Serving Iowa Guard Families

Helping Guard kids grow confident and connected

Wherever duty takes their families.

Adventure Kits

Adventure Kits bring Guard families together with seasonal, hands-on projects that spark curiosity and connection. Each kit includes STEM challenges, health tips, and guided videos families can open anytime, anywhere.

Sign Up

Summer Camp

Summer Camp is back this summer with a week of high-energy adventure, Guard mentors, and late-night cabin laughs. Exact dates drop soon—sign up for camp alerts and we’ll email you as soon as registration opens.

Get Camp Alerts

Military Family Events

Military Family Events connect Guard households across Iowa through regional gatherings and celebrations. These shared moments strengthen community, belonging, and Guard family pride all year long.

Mission

What Guides Our Work

Show up for Guard-connected kids and caregivers with year-round experiences, practical resources, and caring adults so home life stays steady through every drill, mobilization, and return.

Vision

Where We're Headed

Every Iowa Guard kid feels seen, supported, and ready for what's next — and leaders can point to stronger, steadier families because of it.

Partner With Us

From packing adventure kits to hosting family nights, our community partners and volunteers help keep Iowa Guard families supported and ready.

Bring your time, skills, or resources and we’ll put them to good use.

Get Involved Watch Overview

Quick Access Resources

Need support fast? These partners offer tutoring help, counseling, deployment prep, and more. You can always explore the full directory for extra options.

Upwards Drill-Time Child Care

Pilot program providing no-cost childcare for military families during drill weekends and battle assemblies.
